book.name: 1 Tesalonika
book.title: PAS NAMBA WAN PAULO MENI TESALONIKA EMA DUBURE GAENUA

content: Paulo nu nukare emo kotumu-katumu wero Timoti iyetinu bamunua.
Na nikare emo duba naso meni ara tapinoe giro saineba asero na imata Atens nate noise

Timoti potena nisokare nana bamisia. Nu otao nasokai. Nu Anutura bua mai noise Kristora Oziga Ewanana towia ami nisokare nana bamuro tuma diai nisokare emo nikare soremai zewai wawise iyetena bamisia.
Nikare dirina tame noise beyata wai azu, ago wisena. Nikare ninitinowa. Nakai awa dirina tame nuanisekai sai.
Are nakare gita nisokare nana soe noise ge ego senakare awa, “Nakai yaya tamanisekai sai itia.” Are ge awa me wenua, awa ninitinowa awa.
Are etetenaira mama meni nikare puro osesi bua nasora me tepo inoita asero duba naso meni kotumu-katumu bamu wero giro ema ami tuma diai nisokarera susu gaise sesena bamisia awa.
Timoti meni ewesemuro ge uge wenua.

Are Timoti ewesemuro tuma diaire dubara dumi pumai nisokare amira oziga kokopai sisia awa. Ago wero nikare nakare kotupitinowewa amire nakare nikare gamu sawenakare nikare da ago ine nakare gamu towewa, ge awa dapikarago namorekare sero tepo wisia awa.
Otao mamai, dirinare moka yayare meni nakare puro osero baitinu noe donakare tuma diai nisokarera ge awa puro muro sesi ge ami duba nasokare kora weti ewanana wero baitisia awa.
Nikare Tuara nana ereniro zewai inowewa awa gosinoise duba nasokare peu inoya awa.
Utura ge nusokare nana kei awero baitiro itaise Paulo meni isa senua.
Nakare nikare emo wero Anutu nasokaira nana benaura yawa sara bamu inowenakare, are nakare Anuture kokopai nogo nogo sanakare te wamunoi?
Nakare nisokare nana muro ina-ga wero ge eni itera awa susumanakare tuma diai nisokare zewai waise sero pi waiko nu zawa sero begomo towenakare awa.
Mama nasokai Anutu ata Tua nasokai Yesu nu nutope ebata wai amire nisokare nana mamunonakare.
Nisokare nana awa Tua meni dubara dumi nisokare awa-uzai eriro dopai ema enire o nitopekare dubara dumi ina-puma wewo. Nanekare nimorekare inowenakare da ago ine wewo.
Ago wawa Anutu meni duba nisokare ziai zewai wai Tua nasokai Yesu saramai dubu nusore kei awai amire nikare Mama nasokai Anutu amira benaura pasina tepo saramai dopamunowa awa.
